title: Featured place
description: A place shown as a one-tap button on the home page. Cameras are never attached to a place; results come from distance.

radius_miles.description: Default search radius for this place.

order.description: Lower numbers first. Popular places can go first later.

collection.description: Id of a collection (data/collections) this place belongs to. Places in a collection are listed there instead of on the main home list.
